title: Find Building Where Alice and Bob Can Meet
goal: Find the leftmost building where each pair can meet by moving right to strictly taller buildings.
strategy: Resolve pairs that can meet at their right endpoint immediately. For the rest, process right boundaries from right to left; a monotonic skyline retains undominated buildings, and binary search finds the nearest one taller than both starts.
